summary: IM Cannabis Corp. filed a Form 6-K disclosing a private placement of a convertible note and warrant to an institutional investor. The note has a principal of US$225,000, priced at 90% of subscription, convertible at a fixed price of US$3.328 or 90% of the lowest VWAP over 20 days, with a floor of US$0.665692. A warrant for 77,855 shares at CAD$4.63 accompanies the note. Proceeds of US$202,500 will fund general corporate purposes. This is a routine capital-raising instrument, not a special situation.
